g.text: - ProductId is a unique identifier for a product.
- Must be a string representing the product ID.
- Sellable and Pizza Component are Product types.
- A Product MUST have at least one type:
• No type (neither Sellable nor Pizza Component)
- Any Product (regardless of type) may or may not
- A Pizza Component must be associated with
- For pizzas, the selling price is determined
- CategoryId is a unique identifier for a product category.
- Must be a string representing the category ID.
